description: This file contains utility methods related to holiday calculations within the Fineract project, including checks for whether a date falls on a holiday, rescheduling repayment dates, and updating schedule dates when holidays are encountered.

classes.name: HolidayUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for holiday-related date calculations and adjustments.

methods.name: getRepaymentRescheduleDateToIfHoliday
methods.description: Adjusts the repayment date to the next available non-holiday date if the provided date falls on a holiday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a holiday based on a list of holidays.

methods.name: getApplicableHoliday
methods.description: Returns the holiday applicable to a given date if it falls within a holiday period, otherwise null.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date coincides with a specific holiday period.

methods.name: updateRepaymentRescheduleDateToWorkingDayIfItIsHoliday
methods.description: Updates the adjusted date details to a specific reschedule date if the holiday's reschedule type indicates rescheduling to a specific date.
